increases specificity, which prevents the media query to override the property\n    &,\n    .disable-rfs &,\n    &.disable-rfs {\n      @content;\n    }\n  }\n  @else if $rfs-class == enable and $rfs-mode == min-media-query {\n    .enable-rfs &,\n    &.enable-rfs {\n      @content;\n    }\n  } @else {\n    @content;\n  }\n}\n\n// Internal mixin that adds enable classes to the selector if needed.\n@mixin _rfs-media-query-rule {\n\n  @if $rfs-class == enable {\n    @if $rfs-mode == min-media-query {\n      @content;\n    }\n\n    @include _rfs-media-query () {\n      .enable-rfs &,\n      &.enable-rfs {\n        @content;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  @else {\n    @if $rfs-class == disable and $rfs-mode == min-media-query {\n      .disable-rfs &,\n      &.disable-rfs {\n        @content;\n      }\n    }\n    @include _rfs-media-query () {\n      @content;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Helper function to get the formatted non-responsive value\n@function rfs-value($values) {\n  // Convert to list\n  $values: if(type-of($values) != list, ($values,), $values);\n\n  $val: \"\";\n\n  // Loop over each value and calculate value\n  @each $value in $values {\n    @if $value == 0 {\n      $val: $val + \" 0\";\n    }\n    @else {\n      // Cache $value unit\n      $unit: if(type-of($value) == \"number\", unit($value), false);\n\n      @if $unit == px {\n        // Convert to rem if needed\n        $val: $val + \" \" + if($rfs-unit == rem, #{divide($value, $value * 0 + $rfs-rem-value)}rem, $value);\n      }\n      @else if $unit == rem {\n        // Convert to px if needed\n        $val: $val + \" \" + if($rfs-unit == px, #{divide($value, $value * 0 + 1) * $rfs-rem-value}px, $value);\n      } @else {\n        // If $value isn't a number (like inherit) or $value has a unit (not px or rem, like 1.5em) or $ is 0, just print the value\n        $val: $val + \" \" + $value;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Remove first space\n  @return unquote(str-slice($val, 2));\n}\n\n// Helper function to get the responsive value calculated by RFS\n@function rfs-fluid-value($values) {\n  // Convert to list\n  $values: if(type-of($values) != list, ($values,), $values);\n\n  $val: \"\";\n\n  // Loop over each value and calculate value\n  @each $value in $values {\n    @if $value == 0 {\n      $val: $val + \" 0\";\n    } @else {\n      // Cache $value unit\n      $unit: if(type-of($value) == \"number\", unit($value), false);\n\n      // If $value isn't a number (like inherit) or $value has a unit (not px or rem, like 1.5em) or $ is 0, just print the value\n      @if not $unit or $unit != between 0 and $rfs-breakpoint\n          $variable-width: #{divide($value-diff * 100, $rfs-breakpoint)}#{$variable-unit};\n\n          // Return the calculated value\n          $val: $val + \" calc(\" + $min-width + if($value < 0, \" - \", \" + \") + $variable-width + \")\";\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Remove first space\n  @return unquote(str-slice($val, 2));\n}\n\n// RFS mixin\n@mixin () {\n        #{$property}: if($rfs-mode == max-media-query, $fluid-val, $val);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Shorthand helper mixins\n@mixin font-size($value) {\n  @include rfs($value);\n}\n\n@mixin Use `px` or `rem`.\";\n}\n\n// Breakpoint at where values start decreasing if screen width is smaller\n$rfs-breakpoint: 1200px !default;\n$rfs-breakpoint-unit: px !default;\n\n@if $rfs-breakpoint-unit != px and $rfs-breakpoint-unit != em and $rfs-breakpoint-unit != rem {\n  @error \"`#{$rfs-breakpoint-unit}` is not a valid unit for $rfs-breakpoint-unit. Use `px`, `em` or `rem`.\";\n}\n\n// Resize values based on screen height and width\n$rfs-two-dimensional: false !default;\n\n// Factor of decrease\n$rfs-factor: 10 !default;\n\n@if type-of($rfs-factor) != number or $rfs-factor <= 1 {\n  @error \"`#{$rfs-factor}` is not a valid  $rfs-factor, it must be greater than 1.\";\n}\n\n// Mode. unit\n$rfs-base-value-unit: unit($rfs-base-value);\n\n@function divide($dividend, $divisor, $precision: 10) {\n  $sign: if($dividend > 0 and $divisor > 0 or $dividend < 0 and $divisor < 0, 1, -1);\n  $dividend: abs($dividend);\n  $divisor: abs($divisor);\n  @if $dividend == 0 {\n    @return 0;\n  }\n  @if $divisor == 0 {\n    @error \"Cannot divide by 0\";\n  }\n  $remainder: $dividend;\n  $result: 0;\n  $factor: 10;\n  @while ($remainder > 0 and $precision >= 0) {\n    $quotient: 0;\n    @while ($remainder >= $divisor) {\n      $remainder: $remainder - $divisor;\n      $quotient: $quotient + 1;\n    }\n    $result: $result * 10 + $quotient;\n    $factor: $factor * .1;\n    $remainder: $remainder * 10;\n    $precision: $precision - 1;\n    @if ($precision < 0 and $remainder >= $divisor * 5) {\n      $result: $result + 1;\n    }\n  }\n  $result: $result * $factor * $sign;\n  $dividend-unit: unit($dividend);\n  $divisor-unit: unit($divisor);\n  $unit-map: (\n    \"px\": 1px,\n    \"rem\": 1rem,\n    \"em\": 1em,\n    \"%\": 1%\n  );\n  @if ($dividend-unit != $divisor-unit and map-has-key($unit-map, $dividend-unit)) {\n    $result: $result * map-get($unit-map, $dividend-unit);\n  }\n  @return $result;\n}\n\n// Remove px-unit from $rfs-base-value for calculations\n@if $rfs-base-value-unit == px {\n  $rfs-base-value: divide($rfs-base-value, $rfs-base-value * 0 + 1);\n}\n@else if $rfs-base-value-unit == rem {\n  $rfs-base-value: divide($rfs-base-value, divide($rfs-base-value * 0 + 1, $rfs-rem-value));\n}\n\n// Cache $rfs-breakpoint unit to prevent multiple $rfs-breakpoint * 0 + 1);\n}\n@else if $rfs-breakpoint-unit-cache == rem or $rfs-breakpoint-unit-cache == \"em\" {\n  $rfs-breakpoint: divide($rfs-breakpoint, divide($rfs-breakpoint * 0 + 1, $rfs-rem-value));\n}\n\n// Calculate the media query value\n$rfs-mq-value: if($rfs-breakpoint-unit == px, #{$rfs-breakpoint}px, #{divide($rfs-breakpoint, $rfs-rem-value)}#{$rfs-breakpoint-unit});\n$rfs-mq-property-width: if($rfs-mode == max-media-query, max-width, min-width);\n$rfs-mq-property-height: if($rfs-mode == max-media-query, max-height, min-height);\n\n// Internal mixin used to determine which media query needs to be used\n@mixin _rfs-media-query {\n  @if $rfs-two-dimensional {\n    @if $rfs-mode == max-media-query {\n      @media (#{$rfs-mq-property-width}: #{$rfs-mq-value}), (#{$rfs-mq-property-height}: #{$rfs-mq-value}) {\n        @content;\n      }\n    }\n    @else {\n      @media (#{$rfs-mq-property-width}: #{$rfs-mq-value}) and (#{$rfs-mq-property-height}: #{$rfs-mq-value}) {\n        @content;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  @else {\n    @media (#{$rfs-mq-property-width}: #{$rfs-mq-value}) {\n      @content;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Internal mixin that adds disable classes to the selector if needed.\n@mixin _rfs-rule {\n  @if $rfs-class == disable and $rfs-mode == max-media-query {\n    // Adding an extra class print styles\n    @if type-of($utility) == \"map\" and map-get($utility, print) == true {\n      @include generate-utility($utility, \"-print\");\n    }\n  }\n}\n"]}

//  bordered icons
// -------------------------
@use 'variables' as v;

/* Heads Up: Bordered Icons will not be supported in the future!
  - This feature will be deprecated in the next major release of Font Awesome (v8)!
  - You may continue to use it in this version *v7), but it will not be supported in Font Awesome v8.
*/

/* Notes:
* --@{v.$css-prefix}-border-width = 1/16 by default (to render as ~1px based on a 16px default font-size)
* --@{v.$css-prefix}-border-padding =
  ** 3/16 for vertical padding (to give ~2px of vertical whitespace around an icon considering it's vertical alignment)
  ** 4/16 for horizontal padding (to give ~4px of horizontal whitespace around an icon)
*/

.#{v.$css-prefix}-border {
  border-color: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-border-color, #{v.$border-color});
  border-radius: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-border-radius, #{v.$border-radius});
  border-style: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-border-style, #{v.$border-style});
  border-width: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-border-width, #{v.$border-width});
  box-sizing: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-border-box-sizing, #{v.$border-box-sizing});
  padding: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-border-padding, #{v.$border-padding});
}

// mixins
// --------------------------
@use 'variables' as v;

// base rendering for an icon
@mixin fa-icon($family: v.$family) {
  --_#{v.$css-prefix}-family: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-family, var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-style-family, '#{$family}'));
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  display: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-display, #{v.$display});
  font-family: var(--_#{v.$css-prefix}-family);
  font-feature-settings: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  font-synthesis: none;
  font-variant: normal;
  font-weight: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-style, #{v.$style});
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;
  text-rendering: auto;
  width: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-width, #{v.$fw-width});
}

// sets relative font-sizing and alignment (in _sizing)
@mixin fa-size ($font-size) {
  font-size: calc(#{$font-size} / #{v.$size-scale-base} * 1em); /* converts a #{$font-size}px size into an em-based value that's relative to the scale's #{v.$size-scale-base}px base */
  line-height: calc(1 / #{$font-size} * 1em); /* sets the line-height of the icon back to that of it's parent */
  vertical-align: calc(((6 / #{$font-size}) - (3 / 8)) * 1em); /* vertically centers the icon taking into account the surrounding text's descender */
}

// sizing icons
// -------------------------
@use 'variables' as v;
@use 'mixins' as m;

// literal magnification scale
@for $i from 1 through 10 {
  .#{v.$css-prefix}-#{$i}x {
    font-size: $i * 1em;
  }
}

// step-based scale (with alignment)
@each $size, $value in v.$sizes {
  .#{v.$css-prefix}-#{$size} {
     @include m.fa-size($value);
  }
}

/*!
 * Font Awesome Free 7.3.1 by @fontawesome - https://fontawesome.com
 * License - https://fontawesome.com/license/free (Icons: CC BY 4.0, Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1, Code: MIT License)
 * Copyright 2026 Fonticons, Inc.

@use "sass:string";
@use 'variables' as v;
@use 'mixins' as m;

:root, :host {
  --#{v.$css-prefix}-family-classic: '#{ v.$family }';
  --#{v.$css-prefix}-font-solid: normal 900 1em/1 var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-family-classic);

  /* deprecated: this older custom property will be removed next major release */
  --#{v.$css-prefix}-style-family-classic: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-family-classic);
}


@font-face {
  font-family: 'Font Awesome 7 Free';
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-display: v.$font-display;
  src: url('#{v.$font-path}/fa-solid-900.woff2');
}


.fas {
  --#{v.$css-prefix}-family: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-family-classic);
  --#{v.$css-prefix}-style: 900;
}

.#{v.$css-prefix}-classic {
  --#{v.$css-prefix}-family: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-family-classic);
}

.#{v.$css-prefix}-solid {
  --#{v.$css-prefix}-style: 900;
}

// convenience mixin for declaring pseudo-elements by CSS variable,
// including all style-specific font properties and ::before elements.
@mixin icon($var) {
  @include m.fa-icon(Font Awesome 7 Free);
  @extend .#{v.$css-prefix}-solid;
  @extend .#{v.$css-prefix}-classic;

  &::before {
    content: string.unquote("\"#{ $var }\"");
  }
}

// stacking icons
// -------------------------
@use 'variables' as v;

.#{v.$css-prefix}-stack {
  display: inline-block;
  height: 2em;
  line-height: 2em;
  position: relative;
  vertical-align: v.$stack-vertical-align;
  width: v.$stack-width;
}

.#{v.$css-prefix}-stack-1x,
.#{v.$css-prefix}-stack-2x {
  --#{v.$css-prefix}-width: 100%;

  inset: 0;
  position: absolute;
  text-align: center;
  width: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-width);
  z-index: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-stack-z-index, #{v.$stack-z-index});
}

.#{v.$css-prefix}-stack-1x {
  line-height: inherit;
}

.#{v.$css-prefix}-stack-2x {
  font-size: 2em;
}

.#{v.$css-prefix}-inverse {
  color: var(--#{v.$css-prefix}-inverse, #{v.$inverse});
}

// ─── Mixins ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Focus ring
@mixin focus-ring($color: $c-primary) {
  border-color: $color;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba($color, .12);
}

// Button variant: background + text color
@mixin btn-variant($bg, $color: #fff, $hover: null) {
  background: $bg;
  color: $color;
  @if $hover {
    &:hover { background: $hover; }
  } @else {
    &:hover { background: darken($bg, 8%); }
  }
}

// Badge variant
@mixin badge-variant($bg-color, $text-color) {
  background: rgba($bg-color, .12);
  color: $text-color;
}

// Icon color for KPI backgrounds
@mixin kpi-bg($color) {
  background: rgba($color, .10);
  svg { stroke: $color; fill: none; }
}

<!-- Logic JavaScript d'ajout/suppression dynamique avec réindexation -->
<script th:inline="javascript">
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const platsList = /*[[${plats}]]*/ [];
    const container = document.getElementById("lignesContainer");
    const btnAdd = document.getElementById("btnAddPlat");

    function formatNumber(num) {
        if (!num) return "0,00";
        return new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(num);
    }

    function buildOptionsHtml() {
        let optionsHtml = '<option value="">-- Choisir un plat --</option>';
        if (platsList && platsList.length > 0) {
            platsList.forEach(p => {
                const prixStr = p.prixVente != null ? ` - ${formatNumber(p.prixVente)} Ar` : '';
                optionsHtml += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.nom}${prixStr}</option>`;
            });
        }
        return optionsHtml;
    }

    function updateRowIndices() {
        const rows = container.querySelectorAll(".ligne-plat-row");
        rows.forEach((row, index) => {
            const select = row.querySelector(".plat-select");
            const input = row.querySelector(".plat-qty");
            
            select.name = `lignes[${index}].idPlat`;
            input.name = `lignes[${index}].quantite`;
        });
    }

    function ajouterLigne() {
        const index = container.querySelectorAll(".ligne-plat-row").length;
        const tr = document.createElement("tr");
        tr.className = "ligne-plat-row";

        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td>
                <select name="lignes[${index}].idPlat" class="form-control plat-select" required>
                    ${buildOptionsHtml()}
                </select>
            </td>
            <td>
                <input type="number" step="0.01" min="0.01" name="lignes[${index}].quantite" value="1" class="form-control plat-qty" required />
            </td>
            <td class="text-center">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm remove-ligne" title="Supprimer">
                    <i class="bi bi-trash"></i> Supprimer
                </button>
            </td>
        `;

        container.appendChild(tr);
        updateRowIndices();
    }

    btnAdd.addEventListener("click", ajouterLigne);

    container.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target.closest(".remove-ligne")) {
            const row = e.target.closest(".ligne-plat-row");
            row.remove();
            updateRowIndices();
        }
    });

    // S'assurer que les index de départ sont propres
    updateRowIndices();
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    let platIndex = 0;

    // Ajouter un nouveau Plat
    document.getElementById("btnAddPlat").addEventListener("click", function () {
        platIndex++;
        const container = document.getElementById("platsContainer");
        const firstBlock = container.querySelector(".plat-block");
        const newBlock = firstBlock.cloneNode(true);

        newBlock.setAttribute("data-plat-index", platIndex);
        newBlock.querySelector(".plat-number").textContent = platIndex + 1;

        // Réinitialiser les champs textes/selects du plat
        newBlock.querySelector("input[name*='.nom']").name = `plats[${platIndex}].nom`;
        newBlock.querySelector("input[name*='.nom']").value = "";
        
        newBlock.querySelector("select[name*='.idCategorie']").name = `plats[${platIndex}].idCategorie`;
        newBlock.querySelector("select[name*='.idCategorie']").selectedIndex = 0;
        
        newBlock.querySelector("input[name*='.prixVente']").name = `plats[${platIndex}].prixVente`;
        newBlock.querySelector("input[name*='.prixVente']").value = "";

        // Nettoyer les ingrédients pour n'en garder qu'un seul vierge
        const ingContainer = newBlock.querySelector(".ingredients-container");
        ingContainer.setAttribute("data-plat-index", platIndex);
        ingContainer.innerHTML = "";

        // Ajouter un premier ingrédient vide
        appendIngredientRow(ingContainer, platIndex, 0);

        // Afficher le bouton supprimer plat
        const deleteBtn = newBlock.querySelector(".btn-remove-plat");
        deleteBtn.style.display = "block";

        container.appendChild(newBlock);
        updatePlatIndexes();
    });

    // Gestion des événements délégués (Boutons dynamiques)
    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        // Ajouter Ingrédient
        if (e.target.closest(".btn-add-ing")) {
            const platBlock = e.target.closest(".plat-block");
            const pIdx = platBlock.getAttribute("data-plat-index");
            const ingContainer = platBlock.querySelector(".ingredients-container");
            const ingRows = ingContainer.querySelectorAll(".ingredient-row");
            appendIngredientRow(ingContainer, pIdx, ingRows.length);
        }

        // Supprimer Ingrédient
        if (e.target.closest(".btn-remove-ing")) {
            const row = e.target.closest(".ingredient-row");
            const container = row.closest(".ingredients-container");
            if (container.querySelectorAll(".ingredient-row").length > 1) {
                row.remove();
                reindexIngredients(container);
            } else {
                alert("Un plat doit avoir au moins une ligne d'ingrédient.");
            }
        }

        // Supprimer Plat
        if (e.target.closest(".btn-remove-plat")) {
            const block = e.target.closest(".plat-block");
            block.remove();
            updatePlatIndexes();
        }
    });

    function appendIngredientRow(container, pIdx, ingIdx) {
        const template = document.getElementById("ingredientTemplate").content.cloneNode(true);
        const row = template.querySelector(".ingredient-row");
        
        const select = row.querySelector(".ing-select");
        select.name = `plats[${pIdx}].ingredients[${ingIdx}].idIngredient`;

        const input = row.querySelector(".ing-qty");
        input.name = `plats[${pIdx}].ingredients[${ingIdx}].quantiteRequise`;

        container.appendChild(row);
    }

    function reindexIngredients(container) {
        const pIdx = container.getAttribute("data-plat-index");
        const rows = container.querySelectorAll(".ingredient-row");
        rows.forEach((row, ingIdx) => {
            const select = row.querySelector("select");
            const input = row.querySelector("input");
            select.name = `plats[${pIdx}].ingredients[${ingIdx}].idIngredient`;
            input.name = `plats[${pIdx}].ingredients[${ingIdx}].quantiteRequise`;
        });
    }

    function updatePlatIndexes() {
        const blocks = document.querySelectorAll(".plat-block");
        blocks.forEach((block, index) => {
            block.setAttribute("data-plat-index", index);
            block.querySelector(".plat-number").textContent = index + 1;
            
            block.querySelector("input[name*='.nom']").name = `plats[${index}].nom`;
            block.querySelector("select[name*='.idCategorie']").name = `plats[${index}].idCategorie`;
            block.querySelector("input[name*='.prixVente']").name = `plats[${index}].prixVente`;
            
            const ingContainer = block.querySelector(".ingredients-container");
            ingContainer.setAttribute("data-plat-index", index);
            reindexIngredients(ingContainer);

            const deleteBtn = block.querySelector(".btn-remove-plat");
            deleteBtn.style.display = blocks.length > 1 ? "block" : "none";
        });
        platIndex = blocks.length - 1;
    }
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

<!-- Dynamic Rows Script -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const container = document.getElementById('ingredientsContainer');
    const btnAdd = document.getElementById('btnAddIngredient');

    // Mettre à jour les indices des formulaires après chaque modification
    function updateRowIndices() {
        const rows = container.querySelectorAll('.ingredient-row');
        rows.forEach((row, index) => {
            const select = row.querySelector('.produit-select');
            const input = row.querySelector('input[type="number"]');

            select.name = `ingredients[${index}].idProduit`;
            input.name = `ingredients[${index}].quantite`;

            // Désactiver le bouton de suppression s'il n'y a qu'une seule ligne
            const btnRemove = row.querySelector('.remove-row');
            if (rows.length === 1) {
                btnRemove.setAttribute('disabled', 'true');
            } else {
                btnRemove.removeAttribute('disabled');
            }
        });
    }

    // Ajouter une nouvelle ligne
    btnAdd.addEventListener('click', function () {
        const firstRow = container.querySelector('.ingredient-row');
        const newRow = firstRow.cloneNode(true);

        // Réinitialiser les valeurs des inputs clonés
        newRow.querySelector('.produit-select').value = '';
        newRow.querySelector('input[type="number"]').value = '';

        container.appendChild(newRow);
        updateRowIndices();
    });

    // Supprimer une ligne via Event Delegation
    container.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.remove-row')) {
            const rows = container.querySelectorAll('.ingredient-row');
            if (rows.length > 1) {
                e.target.closest('.ingredient-row').remove();
                updateRowIndices();
            }
        }
    });
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

<!-- Script de Filtrage Dynamique côté Client -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const categoryFilter = document.getElementById('categoryFilter');
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.plat-card');
    const noPlatsMessage = document.getElementById('noPlatsMessage');

    categoryFilter.addEventListener('change', function() {
        const selectedCategoryId = this.value;
        let visibleCount = 0;

        cards.forEach(card => {
            const cardCategoryId = card.getAttribute('data-category-id');

            if (selectedCategoryId === 'ALL' || cardCategoryId === selectedCategoryId) {
                card.style.display = 'block';
                visibleCount++;
            } else {
                card.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });

        if (noPlatsMessage) {
            noPlatsMessage.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
        }
    });
});
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" lang="fr"
      th:with="pageTitle=${stock.id == null ? 'Nouveau Relevé de Stock' : 'Modifier Relevé de Stock'}">
<head th:replace="~{layout/head :: head(pageTitle=${pageTitle})}"></head>
<body>

<div class="app">

  <!-- Sidebar globale -->
  <aside th:replace="~{layout/sidebar :: sidebar(activeMenu='stocks')}"></aside>

  <!-- Conteneur principal -->
  <div class="main">

    <!-- Topbar globale -->
    <div th:replace="~{layout/navbar :: topbar(pageTitle=${pageTitle})}"></div>

    <!-- Contenu de la page -->
    <div class="content">

      <div class="page-header">
        <div>
          <h2 th:text="${stock.id == null ? 'Saisir un Relevé de Stock' : 'Modifier le Relevé de Stock'}"></h2>
          <div class="breadcrumb">Accueil / <a th:href="@{/stocks}">Stocks</a> / <span>Formulaire</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-card">
        <form th:action="@{/stocks/save}" th:object="${stock}" method="post">
          <input type="hidden" th:field="*{id}" />

          <div class="form-grid">
            <div class="field-group">
              <label class="field-label">Ingrédient <span class="required">*</span></label>
              <!-- Ajustez th:field="*{ingredient.id}" si votre DTO utilise idIngredient -->
              <select th:field="*{ingredient}" class="form-control" required>
                <option value="">-- Sélectionner un ingrédient --</option>
                <option th:each="ing : ${ingredients}" 
                        th:value="${ing.id}" 
                        th:text="${ing.nom}">
                </option>
              </select>
            </div>
            
            <div class="field-group">
              <label class="field-label">Date Relevé <span class="required">*</span></label>
              <input type="date" th:field="*{dateEtatStock}" class="form-control" required />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="form-grid">
            <div class="field-group">
              <label class="field-label">Quantité <span class="required">*</span></label>
              <input type="number" step="0.001" th:field="*{quantite}" class="form-control" placeholder="0.000" required />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="toolbar">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Enregistrer</button>
            <a th:href="@{/stocks}" class="btn btn-secondary">Annuler</a>
          </div>

        </form>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<div th:replace="~{layout/footer :: footer}"></div>
<th:block th:replace="~{layout/scripts :: scripts}"></th:block>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" lang="fr"
      th:with="pageTitle='Gestion stock'">
<head th:replace="~{layout/head :: head(pageTitle=${pageTitle})}"></head>
<body>

<div class="app">

  <!-- Sidebar globale -->
  <aside th:replace="~{layout/sidebar :: sidebar(activeMenu='stocks')}"></aside>

  <!-- Conteneur principal -->
  <div class="main">
    
    <!-- Topbar globale -->
    <div th:replace="~{layout/navbar :: topbar(pageTitle=${pageTitle})}"></div>

    <!-- Contenu de la page -->
    <div class="content">
      
      <div class="page-header">
        <div>
          <h2>Mise à Jour / État du Stock</h2>
          <div class="breadcrumb">Accueil / <span>Stocks</span></div>
        </div>
        <a th:href="@{/stocks/new}" class="btn btn-primary">Ajuster le Stock</a>
      </div>

      <div class="table-card">
        <table class="data-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>ID</th>
              <th>Ingrédient</th>
              <th>Date Relevé</th>
              <th>Quantité restante</th>
              <th>Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr th:each="s : ${stocksList}">
              <td th:text="${s.id}">1</td>
              <td th:text="${s.ingredient != null ? s.ingredient.nom : 'N/A'}">Ingrédient</td>
              <td th:text="${s.dateEtatStock}">2026-07-30</td>
              <td th:text="${s.quantite != null ? #numbers.formatDecimal(s.quantite, 1, 'POINT', 3, 'COMMA') : '0.000'}">10.000</td>
              <td class="actions">
                <a th:href="@{/stocks/edit/{id}(id=${s.id})}" class="btn btn-warning">Modifier</a>
                <a th:href="@{/stocks/delete/{id}(id=${s.id})}" class="btn btn-danger" onclick="return confirm('Effacer ce relevé de stock ?');">Supprimer</a>
              </td>
            </tr>
            <tr th:if="${#lists.isEmpty(stocksList)}">
              <td colspan="5" class="text-center">Aucun relevé de stock trouvé.</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<div th:replace="~{layout/footer :: footer}"></div>
<th:block th:replace="~{layout/scripts :: scripts}"></th:block>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" lang="fr"
      th:with="pageTitle=${ 'Formulaire Zone de Livraison'}">
<head th:replace="~{layout/head :: head(pageTitle=${pageTitle})}"></head>
<body>
    <div class="app">

    <!-- Sidebar globale avec l'onglet 'caisse' actif -->
  <aside th:replace="~{layout/sidebar :: sidebar(activeMenu='zones-livraison')}"></aside>
        <div class="main">
                    <!-- Topbar globale -->
        <div th:replace="~{fragments/layout :: topbar('zones-livraison')}"></div>

        <div class="content">
           <h1 th:text="${zone.id == null ? 'Ajouter une Zone' : 'Modifier la Zone'}">Titre</h1>
        
            <form th:action="@{/zones-livraison/enregistrer}" th:object="${zone}" method="post" class="mt-3">
                <input type="hidden" th:field="*{id}">
        
                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Libellé</label>
                    <input type="text" th:field="*{libelle}" class="form-control" th:classappend="${#fields.hasErrors('libelle')} ? 'is-invalid'">
                    <div class="invalid-feedback" th:errors="*{libelle}"></div>
                </div>
        
                <div class="row">
                    <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Distance Min</label>
                        <input type="number" step="0.001" th:field="*{min}" class="form-control" th:classappend="${#fields.hasErrors('min')} ? 'is-invalid'">
                        <div class="invalid-feedback" th:errors="*{min}"></div>
                    </div>
        
                    <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label">Distance Max</label>
                        <input type="number" step="0.001" th:field="*{max}" class="form-control" th:classappend="${#fields.hasErrors('max')} ? 'is-invalid'">
                        <div class="invalid-feedback" th:errors="*{max}"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
        
                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label class="form-label">Prix</label>
                    <input type="number" step="0.01" th:field="*{prix}" class="form-control" th:classappend="${#fields.hasErrors('prix')} ? 'is-invalid'">
                    <div class="invalid-feedback" th:errors="*{prix}"></div>
                </div>
        
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success">Enregistrer</button>
                <a th:href="@{/zones-livraison}" class="btn btn-secondary">Annuler</a>
            </form>
        </div>
        </div>

    </div>


<div th:replace="~{layout/footer :: footer}"></div>
<th:block th:replace="~{layout/scripts :: scripts}"></th:block>
</body>
</html>

Zones de Livraison
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" lang="fr"
      th:with="pageTitle=${ 'Zones de Livraison'}">
<head th:replace="~{layout/head :: head(pageTitle=${pageTitle})}"></head>
<body>
    <div class="app">
          <aside th:replace="~{layout/sidebar :: sidebar(activeMenu='zones-livraison')}"></aside>

        <div class="main">
                    <!-- Topbar globale -->
        <div th:replace="~{fragments/layout :: topbar('zones-livraison')}"></div>

        <div class="content">
            <h2>Gestion des Zones de Livraison</h2>
        
            <div th:if="${successMessage}" class="alert alert-success" th:text="${successMessage}"></div>
            <div th:if="${errorMessage}" class="alert alert-danger" th:text="${errorMessage}"></div>
        
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between mb-3">
                <form th:action="@{/zones-livraison}" method="get" th:object="${filter}" class="d-flex gap-2">
                    <input type="text" th:field="*{search}" class="form-control" placeholder="Rechercher par libellé...">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-secondary">Filtrer</button>
                </form>
                <a th:href="@{/zones-livraison/creer}" class="btn btn-primary">Ajouter une Zone</a>
            </div>
        
            <table class="table table-striped border">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>ID</th>
                        <th>Libellé</th>
                        <th>Distance Min (km)</th>
                        <th>Distance Max (km)</th>
                        <th>Prix (Ariary)</th>
                        <th>Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    <tr th:each="z : ${page.content}">
                        <td th:text="${z.id}">1</td>
                        <td th:text="${z.libelle}">Zone A</td>
                        <td th:text="${z.min}">0.000</td>
                        <td th:text="${z.max}">5.000</td>
                        <td th:text="${#numbers.formatDecimal(z.prix, 1, 'POINT', 2, 'COMMA')}">5.00</td>
                        <td class="d-flex gap-1">
                            <a th:href="@{/zones-livraison/modifier/{id}(id=${z.id})}" class="btn btn-sm btn-warning">Modifier</a>
                            <form th:action="@{/zones-livraison/supprimer/{id}(id=${z.id})}" method="post" onsubmit="return confirm('Confirmer la suppression ?');">
                                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger">Supprimer</button>
                            </form>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr th:if="${#lists.isEmpty(page.content)}">
                        <td colspan="6" class="text-center">Aucune zone de livraison trouvée.</td>
                    </tr>
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

        </div>
    </div>
    <div th:replace="~{layout/footer :: footer}"></div>
<th:block th:replace="~{layout/scripts :: scripts}"></th:block>
</body>
</html>
